description: This file is a shell script used for managing the SSH server (dropbear) on a device. It includes functions to start, stop, and restart the SSH daemon, as well as handling different system events such as LAN/WAN status and bridge status.

methods.name: do_start
methods.description: Starts the dropbear SSH daemon with configuration parameters.

methods.name: do_stop
methods.description: Stops the dropbear SSH daemon process.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the SSH service based on system status.

methods.name: service_lanwan_status
methods.description: Manages SSH service based on LAN and WAN status events.

methods.name: service_bridge_status
methods.description: Manages SSH service based on bridge status events.
